goal: Compare implementable terminal-supervised credit methods on the final simplified chapter3 A policy
metric: original terminal return x100; SSIM score for radio and mean regional completion score for v5
learning_summary: normalized trapezoidal AUC over fixed 0..480 development checkpoints
selection: development curves only; fixed endpoint; no best checkpoint; holdout never used for training or hyperparameter tuning
statistical_unit: independent training seed; path samples not independent training seeds
uncertainty: paired seed differences and descriptive 95% t intervals; n3 pilot does not establish universal effects
extra_cost: all auxiliary optimizers, KL rollback attempts, CUDA training wall time and evaluation separately logged
engineering: all nine methods both domains 40 fresh episodes, 2 development paths, no holdout; must pass before formal screen
scope: ordinary observations, complete trajectories and native terminal scalar only; no privileged continuation or hidden labels

not_implemented_as_ordinary_feedback.temporal_shapley: requires separately justified coalition evaluator or resettable counterfactual simulator
not_implemented_as_ordinary_feedback.align_rudder: requires demonstration data absent from fair baseline
not_implemented_as_ordinary_feedback.offpolicy_dae_innovation: heavier stochastic-model extension reserved pending identified need; ordinary DAE already tested historically
not_implemented_as_ordinary_feedback.rrd_sac: requires independently working matched SAC backend; no silent replacement by previously failed TD3
